parameters.text:
=You are enriching an advisor CRM record for assignment in a wealth advisory workflow.

Return valid JSON only with exactly these keys:
advisor_category, normalized_specializations, client_segment_focus, service_tier, ideal_budget_band, service_regions, intake_quality, ai_summary, next_action

Advisor data:
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

Rules:
- advisor_category must be one of: Wealth Advisor, Retirement Advisor, Mutual Fund Advisor, Tax Advisor, Investment Advisor, Insurance Advisor, General Advisor
- normalized_specializations must be an array using only these values when relevant:
  ["wealth_management","retirement_planning","sip","mutual_funds","tax_planning","portfolio_management","stock_investing","insurance","goal_planning","estate_planning"]
- client_segment_focus must be one of: HNI, Retail, Mixed
- service_tier must be one of: Premium, Standard, Entry
- ideal_budget_band must be one of: High, Mid, Standard
- service_regions must be an array of city/region strings and can include the advisor city
- intake_quality must be one of: Strong, Moderate, Basic
- ai_summary must be 2 short sentences
- next_action must be one clear CRM action
- infer from the advisor data only
- return JSON only

parameters.content:
## Webhook Lead Capture to AI-Based Wealth Scoring & CRM Logging (AI + Sheets + Follow-Up System)

### How it works  
This workflow captures advisor and lead data via webhook, normalizes and routes it into separate processing flows. Advisors are scored, enriched with AI, and stored with structured profiles. Leads are enriched using AI and assigned to the best-fit advisor using semantic + rule-based matching.  

A daily follow-up system identifies due actions and sends emails to both lead and advisor. Additionally, a dedicated advisor follow-up webhook allows advisors to update lead status, next actions, and follow-up requirements. These updates trigger CRM updates, notifications, and logging—ensuring real-time lifecycle tracking.  

### Setup steps  
1. Connect Google Sheets (Advisors, Leads, Activity Log)  
2. Configure Gmail credentials (lead + advisor notifications)  
3. Set AI model (Gemini/OpenAI) in AI nodes  
4. Ensure sheet columns match workflow fields  
5. Configure webhook endpoints (lead capture + advisor follow-up)  
6. Activate workflow and test via webhook

## Input & Routing

Captures webhook data, standardizes fields, and routes records based on type (advisor or lead).
Ensures consistent structure before processing.

## Advisor Processing

Reads advisor data, checks duplicates, calculates score, enriches using AI, and prepares final advisor record.

## Advisor Storage & Logging

Stores advisor data in CRM and logs the action for tracking and audit purposes.

## Lead Processing

Reads lead data, checks duplicates, calculates score, enriches using AI, and prepares lead for assignment.

## Lead Assignment & Notification

Assigns best available advisor based on score and capacity, then notifies advisor and logs activity.

nodes.name: Read Leads CRM For Advisor Update

parameters.jsCode:
const update = $('Normalize Advisor Followup Update').first().json;
const rows = $input.all().map(i => i.json).filter(r => Object.keys(r || {}).length > 0);

const match = rows.find(r => String(r.lead_id || '').trim() === update.lead_id);
if (!match) {
  return [{ json: { success: false, lead_id: update.lead_id, message: 'Lead not found for advisor follow-up update.' } }];
}

const noteLine = `ADVISOR_FOLLOWUP_UPDATE::${update.updated_at} | Advisor: ${update.advisor_name || 'Unknown'} | Contact Status: ${update.contact_status}${update.update_note ? ' | Note: ' + update.update_note : ''}`;
const existingNotes = String(match.notes || '').trim();
const mergedNotes = existingNotes ? `${existingNotes}\n${noteLine}` : noteLine;

return [{
  json: {
    success: true,
    lead_id: match.lead_id,
    lead_name: match.lead_name,
    lead_email: match.lead_email,
    lead_phone: match.lead_phone,
    city: match.city,
    interest_area: match.interest_area,
    budget_range: match.budget_range,
    lead_source: match.lead_source,
    lead_score: match.lead_score,
    lead_grade: match.lead_grade,
    priority: match.priority,
    priority_queue_rank: match.priority_queue_rank,
    status: update.lead_status,
    assigned_advisor_id: update.advisor_id || match.assigned_advisor_id || '',
    assigned_advisor_name: update.advisor_name || match.assigned_advisor_name || '',
    assigned_advisor_email: update.advisor_email || match.assigned_advisor_email || '',
    advisor_match_score: match.advisor_match_score,
    urgency: match.urgency,
    intent: match.intent,
    ai_summary: match.ai_summary,
    next_action: update.next_action || match.next_action || '',
    next_action_date: update.next_action_date || '',
    follow_up_required: update.follow_up_required,
    last_contacted_at: update.last_contacted_at,
    created_at: match.created_at,
    updated_at: update.updated_at,
    duplicate_flag: match.duplicate_flag,
    notes: mergedNotes,
    interaction_count: Number(match.interaction_count || 0) + 1,
    wealth_score: match.wealth_score,
    investment_potential: match.investment_potential,
    advisor_name: update.advisor_name || match.assigned_advisor_name || '',
    advisor_email: update.advisor_email || match.assigned_advisor_email || '',
    contact_status: update.contact_status,
    update_note: update.update_note
  }
}];

parameters.content:
## Advisor Follow-Up Intake & Normalization

This section receives advisor follow-up updates via webhook, normalizes fields such as follow_up_required, next_action, and contact_status, then fetches the latest lead record from the CRM and merges the advisor input with existing data to prepare a clean, structured update for consistency.

## Advisor Update Execution, Notifications & Logging

This section applies advisor updates to the lead record in the CRM, sends a confirmation email to the advisor after a successful update, conditionally sends a next-step email to the lead if follow-up is required, logs the action once, and finally returns a webhook response.

## Follow-Up Detection & Notifications

This section runs on a daily trigger to identify leads requiring follow-up. It reads lead data from the CRM, filters records based on follow_up_required, next_action_date, and valid contact details, and sends reminder emails to both the lead and the assigned advisor to ensure timely engagement.

## Follow-Up Tracking & Logging

This section updates the lead record after follow-up reminders are sent by adding timestamps and notes, ensuring accurate tracking of interactions. It also logs each follow-up action to maintain a history and prevent duplicate reminders.

## Dashboard & Insights

This section aggregates lead and advisor data to generate dashboard metrics for monitoring performance. It merges CRM data, builds structured summary rows, and stores them for tracking total leads, assignments, follow-ups, and overall system activity.
